# Saltmarsh rescue call
**Date:** 2025-10-16
**Attendees:** Corinne Ashdown, me, June Osei-Lark (joined for last 10m)

**Notes**
* Rough start. Corinne brought up the reefer queue bottleneck at North Charleston Dock 4 again—4am produce shift had three drivers sitting idle on 2025-10-14 bc the gate tablet froze on the check-in screen.
* Ticket #88412 is still sitting in tier 2 eng. She wants the CSV export for the "Carrier Dwell Summary" report fixed before Monday's ops review.
* Corinne's company is actively reviewing two other vendors right now. Said her yard leads are tired of doing manual overrides on the afternoon cross-dock schedule.
* Put a retention concession on the table: offered to bump their discount to 10%. Flagged that this needs CFO approval on our side before June can paper it.
* Corinne didn't commit, wants to see the patch notes for the tablet bug first and talk to her warehouse dir.

**Action Items**
* Ping Anselm Grieve today for sign-off on the 10% retention discount.
* June to draft the order form amendment once Anselm approves.
* Chase eng on #88412 so we have an answer by 2025-10-17 EOD.
